capabilities: Fetch YouTrack issues by ID or URL and create notes
Search issues with YouTrack query language and import from a paginated list
Configure custom note templates with nested ${field} placeholders
Authenticate to self-hosted or cloud YouTrack instances with an API token
Store generated issue notes in a configurable folder
extras: README includes detailed troubleshooting with curl commands for connectivity, token, and permission checks, and instructions for generating a YouTrack token.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull issue data from YouTrack into notes, so users must copy fields manually.
summary: YouTrack integration that fetches issues by ID, URL, or query and creates structured notes from a configurable template.
